admin.tf.title: Two-step verification
admin.tf.setupIntro: Admin accounts need a second step before anything can be changed. Set it up once with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
admin.tf.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with the app, or choose “enter a setup key” and type this key:
admin.tf.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
admin.tf.step2: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app shows now.
admin.tf.verifyIntro: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to open the admin panel.
admin.tf.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
admin.tf.recoveryBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. They are shown only now: keep them somewhere safe, not on the same phone.
admin.tf.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
admin.tf.err.invalid: That code is not right. Check that the time on your phone is correct, then try the next code.
admin.tf.err.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
admin.tf.err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin.tf.dev: Development only: the code the app would show now is {code}.
admin.tf.needCode: Type the 6 digits (or the whole recovery code).
admin.tf.needSaved: Tick the box to confirm that you saved the recovery codes.
